raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Paged causal THD attention sends every softmax exponential through MUFU, even on interior tiles that need no causal masking. Reuse the existing mixed-exp2 implementation for 16 of each 128 columns on eligible interior tiles, distributing some exponent work to the FMA pipeline. Diagonal and other masked tiles retain their existing implementation.

The extension is limited to SM100 BF16 D128-flavor, unsplit, causal paged attention without a sliding window, bias, or an explicit KV mask. It changes no public API, knob, workspace, launch count, plan cache, or per-run host preparation. Nonpaged and split-KV paths, FP16, SM103, and SM107 retain their existing behavior. This complements the nonpaged work in #1702; the shared source block needs reconciliation when either PR lands.

Validation:

- The three changed files are byte-identical to the locally qualified candidate: 44 focused pytest cases passed, covering dtype/page/layout/shape combinations and the existing architecture gates.
- Eight prepared capture/rebind contracts with 16 compiled owners passed on both DSL 4.8 and the 4.7 floor; those case sets overlap. Memcheck, racecheck, and synccheck reported zero errors for the B33 dynamic-length case across all three schedulers.
- Integrated onto current develop `f05b536c`; changed-file formatting/license checks pass. Current-head upstream CI is requested separately.

Tests extend existing suites and check numerics, dynamic metadata, pointer rebinding, and capture behavior. There are no timing thresholds or heuristic-winner golden tests. This PR makes no serving-throughput claim.

files.patch:
@@ -296,17 +296,27 @@
 # exp2 split MUFU / FMA (``_E2E_*``): of every _E2E_FREQ P columns the LAST _E2E_RES are evaluated on the FMA
 # pipe (``exp2_emul_pair``, a degree-3 polynomial + exponent insert), the rest on MUFU.EX2 -- the sm100 d128
 # MXFP8 / FP8 kernels' pattern.  Two trace-time gates fold it in or out: ``PARAMS.exp2_fma_split`` (api_dsl,
-# cc 10.0 only -- cc 10.3's MUFU runs at twice the rate and the split loses there) AND a dense band: on the
-# causal / sliding-window builds the split measured a loss on cc 10.0 (the masked diagonal tiles pay the FMA
-# work without the MUFU relief), so those builds keep every column on MUFU.  Off, both exp2 sites below trace
-# the develop spelling and the module is IR-identical to the unsplit kernel.  Padding (THD / seq_kv_lens) is
-# not a band and keeps the split.
+# cc 10.0 only -- cc 10.3 retains its all-MUFU path) AND a tile/layout gate. Dense bands keep their
+# existing mix. Paged BF16 D128 causal THD mixes only unmasked interior tiles; diagonal, sliding-window,
+# bias and explicit KV-mask tiles retain MUFU. This extension does not change nonpaged or split-KV builds.
 _E2E_FREQ = 16
 _E2E_RES = 4
 _E2E_LIMIT = CFG.TILE_N
 _SOFTMAX_CHUNK = 64  # tcgen05_ld width of one softmax chunk (see _softmax_kv_body CHUNK)
 _E2E_DENSE_BAND = (CFG.MASK_FLAGS & (MASK_CAUSAL | MASK_SWA)) == 0
-_E2E_ENABLED = bool(PARAMS.exp2_fma_split) and _E2E_DENSE_BAND
+_E2E_PAGED_INTERIOR = bool(
+    CFG.THD_VARLEN
+    and CFG.PAGED_KV
+    and CFG.DTYPE_QKV == 2
+    and PARAMS.d_flavor == 128
+    and CFG.SPLIT_KV == 1
+    and not CFG.BIAS_MODE
+    and not CFG.KV_MASK_FORM
+    and (CFG.MASK_FLAGS & (MASK_CAUSAL | MASK_SWA)) == MASK_CAUSAL
+)
+if _E2E_PAGED_INTERIOR:
+    _E2E_RES = 2
+_E2E_ENABLED = bool(PARAMS.exp2_fma_split) and (_E2E_DENSE_BAND or _E2E_PAGED_INTERIOR)
